status: Proposed implementation design authorized by the user; not a claim that these systems are already playable
source: User confirmed the guild prototype was unfinished and asked us to design and implement the system

identity.guild: Stable guild ID independent of leader connection or player pawn
identity.member: Persistent authenticated player identity, never a client-supplied display name
identity.settlement: Stable settlement ID linked to guild ID; world actors carry stable instance IDs
identity.party: Separate membership and lifecycle; joining a party does not grant guild permissions

authority_and_visibility: Clients submit requests through their own player controller; the server derives the requesting identity from the connection
Server checks current membership, permission, range, world/session and definition for every request
Replicate member management and bank details only to authorized viewers; nearby nonmembers may see public building appearance
Client placement ghosts are presentation only; server validates the final transform and spawns the actual building
Use the existing item definitions and inventory transaction rules for materials and currencies, avoiding a second unrelated wallet

permissions.model: Configurable permission sets per role, checked on the server
permissions.defaults: Leader receives all permissions. Member deposits are permitted. Other permissions are explicitly configured; role labels alone do not grant authority.
permissions.leader_transition: Transfer leadership explicitly before a leader leaves; a disconnect does not transfer ownership

bank.storage: Guild-owned item stacks with stable IDs and configured capacity
bank.transfer: Plan source and destination changes together, reject insufficient balance or capacity, then commit both while preventing reentrant mutation
bank.equipment: Reject depositing worn items; item ownership and identity are preserved through transfers
bank.concurrency: Server serializes mutations and records operation results so retransmitted requests cannot duplicate accepted actions

buildings.commit: Validate and prepare spawn before consuming costs. Publish the completed instance and resource changes together; failed creation leaves materials unchanged.
buildings.balance: Prototype screenshot numbers are examples. Costs, limits and bonuses live in editable definitions.

farming_and_production.growth: Server timestamps and configured crop duration; replicate state changes rather than ticking every plot on each client
farming_and_production.harvest: Permission and range checked once; output capacity checked before resetting a ready crop; repeated harvest requests cannot produce duplicate yields
farming_and_production.production: Configured recipe consumes inputs and adds outputs atomically to the guild store; blocked output capacity pauses production without losing inputs
farming_and_production.villagers: Stable worker identity assigned to at most one building, within configured capacity
farming_and_production.offline_policy: Explicit setting; initial implementation advances only while the authoritative settlement session is running until offline catch-up is separately tested

technology_and_reputation.technology: Definition-driven prerequisites, costs and ranked effects; validate before charging; prevent repeated unlocks
technology_and_reputation.reputation: Server-owned progression with explicit sources and thresholds
technology_and_reputation.tax_and_upkeep: Configurable scheduling and denominations; no screenshot values hardcoded as recovered formulas

ui.interaction: UI displays authoritative snapshots and sends requests; inventory, bank and building totals refresh from replicated results
ui.pending_requests: Show pending/result feedback; a locally disabled button is not a substitute for server validation

delivery_order: Implement and test shared inventory transfers and vendor transactions
Implement guild identity, membership, role permissions and bank
Implement territory and one complete material-funded building placement/upgrade path
Implement one complete farm crop and one staffed production recipe
Connect management tabs, technology and reputation
Persist guild and settlement state and verify travel/reconnect behavior
acceptance_scenarios: Nonmembers and members without a permission cannot mutate guild state
Two members competing for the last materials produce only the affordable outcome
Failed placement, full bank or failed actor creation preserves materials
Repeated placement, harvest, withdrawal and research requests cannot duplicate outputs
A late-joining member sees current bank, buildings, workers and crops
Leaving or being removed revokes access immediately
Saving and reopening preserves IDs, quantities and completed actions without repeating rewards
